text:
Maya: Ran a verbose nsys + perfetto capture on 8xA100 (TP=4, PP=2). Seeing recurring ~1.2s latency spikes every ~12s during long prompts — spikes line up with NCCL allreduce windows in the trace. Attaching qdrep and perfetto link.
PerfBot: Automated upload: /artifacts/1737001234/nsys_8xA100_run.qdrep :thumbsup:
Tomas: Got the capture, loading in Nsight. Initial skim: kernel-selector log shows occasional redispatch to a fallback float32 GEMM for the same op pattern that normally uses an int8 path.
Li: selector snippet:
```
batching_heuristic=aggressive
kernel_policy=heuristic-v2
force_int8=false
kv_prefetch=enabled
```
Olga: Correlated with perfetto flame: when the redispatch happens on GPU3 we see a KV cache eviction + host->device memcpy burst that blocks the compute stream. NCCL timeline shows allreduce overlapping that memcpy window (nvlink busy) — likely worse under TP slice reshuffle.
Maya: Hypothesis: the tensor-slice reshard triggers a code-path in dispatcher that invalidates warm KV entries, causing full KV refill (big memcpy) while an allreduce is in-flight, producing the 1.2s stall.
Tomas: Quick mitigations to try:
• Disable aggressive batching for the affected module
• Force kernel-policy to int8 for matching shapes
• Increase kv-prefetch depth so warmups survive redispatch
Li: Ran a local smoke with `RDW_KV_PREFETCH_DEPTH=4` and `RDW_BATCHING_HEURISTIC=conservative` — observed one less spike in a 10-min run. Relevant log lines:
```
[2025-07-15T07:12:01Z] kv_warmup=hit layer=decoder_5
[2025-07-15T07:12:13Z] kv_warmup=miss layer=decoder_9 -> triggering memcpy 312MB
```
Olga: Can we repro with NCCL debug + parallel launch? Please capture with env:
```
NCCL_DEBUG=INFO
NCCL_LAUNCH_MODE=PARALLEL
NVTX_ENABLE=1
``` 
and ensure dispatcher wraps ops with nvtx markers.
Maya: Will schedule a run on `serving-prod-debug-8` with those envs and nvtx markers. Uploading perfetto slice afterwards: http://perfetto.local/trace/1737001234 :eyes:
PerfBot: Run scheduled on GPU pool `serving-prod-debug-8` at 2025-07-15T07:18:00Z
Tomas: If repros, we should add a selector guard to prevent redispatch mid-request (or at least delay KV invalidation until after allreduce completes). Also consider tracking KV LRU usage per-slice so we avoid full refills.
Maya: Agreed. I'll post the new capture when done and include the nvprof/nsys CPU thread sampling. Thanks — will follow up with digest and small reproducer script.
